services.name: Bespoke Scissor Cut & Wash

services.name: The Marylebone Cut & Shave

services.name: Traditional Wet Shave
services.description: Badger-brush lather, double-pass straight razor shave, chilled cedar towel and moisturiser.

services.name: Beard Restyle & Hot Towel
services.description: Scissor-over-comb shaping, crisp throat and cheek razor finish, nourishing botanical oil.

services.name: Executive Taper & Neck Tidy
services.description: Between-cut refresh around the hairline, sideburns and neckline.

reviews.author: Oliver W.
reviews.text: Calm, attentive and genuinely skilled with longer scissor cuts. Easily my favourite barber in Marylebone.

reviews.author: James P.
reviews.text: The traditional wet shave is worth every penny. Unhurried from start to finish and you walk out feeling sharp.

about: Founded by master barbers trained on Savile Row and Jermyn Street, Chiltern Grooming Club offers quiet, appointment-led grooming in the heart of Marylebone. Every service begins with an honest consultation and finishes with a steam towel and complimentary espresso.
